newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent slips as equity holder sells sole date.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent slips as equity holder sells sole date.

text.p: A Brent cargo loading Feb 12-14 traded at March Brent +34.5 cents on Monday, nearly 14 cents below a Dated deal on Friday, traders said.
The Brent, the sole cargo due to turn wet on Monday with Feb 11-13 dates, was deferred a day by equity holder Elf and sold to a Wall Street refiner.
A second cargo which had been scheduled for Feb 11-13 was advanced to Feb 10-12 and was bought Friday by a trader short to a refiner for March Brent +48 cents.
Dealers said first half February North Sea supply was still tight but that demand from the U.S. Gulf, which helped propel spot differentials higher last week, appeared to be easing.
"There were some sales into the Gulf at about WTI minus 50 cents but you won't see a bid above minus 75 cents now," said a trader.
